requires: separate owner authorization for identified isolated synthetic clone
verified clone identity, no real Home/Auth/Storage data and tested restore
reviewed additive schema, actor resolver, RLS/ACL and immutable audit
bounded statement/lock/resource limits and redacted evidence capture

cases.precondition: Synthetic qualified version 1 and two independent transactions on one Source
cases.action: Race version-2 transfer against first canonical Event acceptance
cases.invariant: One committed serialized version owns Event; never camera-time attribution or mixed Site/Tenant
cases.evidence: Sanitized acceptance version, transfer CAS result, binding and audit counts
cases.failure: Missing, mixed or retroactively changed acceptance version

cases.precondition: Synthetic candidate at current version 1 with two independently authorized actors
cases.invariant: Exactly one CAS succeeds and one immutable audit pair is committed
cases.evidence: Version count, CAS outcomes and audit references
cases.failure: Both succeed, gap appears or un-audited success

cases.precondition: Accepted synthetic Signal and binding already committed
cases.action: Retry exact same Event payload and identity
cases.invariant: One canonical Event, one acceptance, one binding, original version retained
cases.evidence: Scoped row counts and original reference equality

cases.precondition: Event ID previously accepted with version 1
cases.action: Retry same ID with changed Source, Site or authority version
cases.invariant: Conflict rejected, original immutable rows retained and conflict audited
cases.evidence: Denial category and unchanged row fingerprints
cases.failure: 23505 treated as semantic equality or overwrite

cases.precondition: Acceptance and audit committed; client did not receive response
cases.action: Reconnect and retry the same synthetic Event
cases.invariant: Original receipt returned with no new binding, audit or owner choice
cases.evidence: Receipt identity and before/after scoped counts

cases.invariant: No partial Event/acceptance/audit; next valid attempt can commit
cases.evidence: Zero partial scoped rows followed by one complete set
cases.failure: Orphan receipt, audit or blocked retry

cases.precondition: Synthetic scoped audit write failure in same transaction
cases.action: Attempt qualification, acceptance and binding separately
cases.invariant: Every affected transaction fails closed with no apparent success
cases.evidence: Error class, absence of partial rows and retry eligibility

cases.precondition: Event bound to version 1, current Source transferred to version 2
cases.action: Replay original Event and read ownership
cases.invariant: Original Tenant/Site/Source and version 1 remain authoritative
cases.evidence: Immutable reference comparison; current pointer is version 2
cases.failure: Replay uses current owner or changes recipients

cases.precondition: Synthetic missing Tenant, Site, owner, or contradictory Source relationship
cases.action: Attempt qualification and new Event binding
cases.invariant: No qualified version or ownership claim is created
cases.evidence: Denial category and zero scoped writes
cases.failure: Nullable association or client value fills the gap

cases.precondition: Pre-existing synthetic Signal without server acceptance/version receipt
cases.invariant: Unqualified; Signal preserved without automatic backfill
cases.evidence: Missing receipt classification and unchanged Signal count
cases.failure: Current Site or timestamp inferred as historical authority

cases.precondition: Synthetic installer, Site member, inactive owner and role-labelled user
cases.action: Attempt registration and transfer as each identity
cases.invariant: Only independently verified owner or qualified Platform Admin can succeed
cases.evidence: Resolved actor provenance, denial classes and audit
cases.failure: created_by, profile.role, email or caller boolean alone grants authority

cases.precondition: Synthetic owner change with frozen decision-time recipient snapshot
cases.action: Replay Event after recipient preference/revocation change
cases.invariant: Registration owner never adds recipients; original snapshot does not expand
cases.evidence: Before/after snapshot fingerprints and no external delivery
cases.failure: Ownership lookup alters recipients or bypasses revocation

cases.precondition: Reviewed schema on isolated clone with synthetic anon, authenticated, service and intended internal roles
cases.action: Probe table/function grants, RLS row boundaries, inherited roles and Data API exposure
cases.invariant: No public or cross-Tenant registration read/write; only qualified internal path writes
cases.evidence: Redacted role-by-operation allow/deny matrix and catalog snapshot
cases.failure: PUBLIC EXECUTE, bypassing definer, direct Data API mutation or cross-scope access

cases.precondition: Synthetic committed and uncommitted operations in isolated clone
cases.action: Terminate only test client, reconnect and compare; plan server restart separately
cases.invariant: Committed rows remain and uncommitted rows roll back; server restart NOT PROVEN here
cases.evidence: Transactional scoped counts and explicit durability limitation
cases.failure: Client termination reported as PostgreSQL restart durability proof
